description: Open errands and list items of people in the connected person's Circle, for people who turned on assistant access for them, with how long each has waited and whether it was already asked of or accepted by the connected person. When an errand lists what it is for, 'items' names them (a 'Groceries' errand with items oat milk, eggs, paper towels): name those items in the answer. An empty 'items' means no items are shared for that errand. Use for 'what does everyone need', 'what has Mom asked for', 'did anyone already get the milk'. People who did not turn on access do not appear. Needs a connected account with Circle access.

category.description: A kind of errand or a word from it: grocery, pharmacy, returns, milk.

person.description: First name to narrow to one person.
